contract: F-25, the skills contract (plan Appendix B), with W-65 as T2.14 built it and its fix round 2 (review R2-3): the reason a reconcile gives for an unavailable row
provenance: Hand-written on 2026-11-25 at commit 1ab4685d from the review's finding R2-3 and its disposition (an installed skill whose folder a newer version rewrote reads 'Needs newer app', not 'Files missing'). An addition beside verdicts.json, which stays as T2.10 locked it; the folders are this set's own. Locked by ../../golden-fixtures.sha256.

verdicts.unavailableReason: needsNewerApp: the row is unavailable because its folder now holds a skill made for a newer version (the discovery code needsNewerApp); null otherwise: an available row, a vanished folder, an invalid one, or an app version the gate cannot read. Derived by each reconcile, never stored: enabled, reason (disabled_reason) and available (unavailable_at IS NULL) are the F-25 columns of verdicts.json

sequences.name: a folder a newer version rewrote reads as made for a newer version until it validates again or vanishes
a folder turned invalid with no newer minimum stays a plain unavailable row
